name: sui_mcp
summary: Sui on-chain connector — settlement, NFT mint, and DeFi lend/borrow for the dApp. Stdlib-only (subprocess + json) shelling out to the `sui` CLI binary on PATH. Wallet resolved through studio/auth/keys.upstream_key('sui'); package IDs (TROLLN, SYNTH, lending) pulled from .env via load_env. Every successful tool call appends one InferenceRecord with model='sui'; tier='monetization' for balance/transfer/mint/tx_status, tier='defi_loop' for lend_pool_deposit / lend_pool_borrow. Scope=f'sui_<tool>'. Mainnet writes are hard-gated behind an explicit confirm=true parameter — devnet/testnet treat the playground as free-fire. Sensitive params (keypair, encryption_key, confirm) are redacted before crystallization.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp + deepseek_mcp shape. SERVICE='sui'. Each tool composes a `sui client …` argv, dispatched via subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=60s). Smoke-validates connection via `sui client active-env`. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). The CLI's JSON output is normalized: list responses (e.g. balance) are wrapped under '_list' before further parsing.

env_vars.SUI_KEYPAIR: signing keypair file or string (NEVER logged)
env_vars.TROLLN_PACKAGE_ID: deployed TROLLN Move package — used by nft_mint
env_vars.AGENT_REGISTRY_ID: on-chain agent registry shared object id
env_vars.SUI_LENDING_PACKAGE_ID: deployed lending pool package — optional; lend_* tools return graceful failure if unset
env_vars.SUI_USDC_COIN_TYPE: override for the canonical bridged USDC coin type (default = Wormhole USDC mainnet address; documented as TEXT-PLACEHOLDER)

substrate: studio/third_party/sui/ (per-config persistence) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/sui_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored monetization + defi_loop records, model='sui')

outbound_calls: inference_logger.log (every call: model='sui'; tier='monetization' default, tier='defi_loop' for lend_*)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: SUI_WALLET via keys.upstream_key('sui'); all package IDs + network via studio/auth/keys.load_env (mirrored .env between MySpace++ and gently)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal_chain monetization / defi_loop records (sensitive params redacted)

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful tool call has a deterministic InferenceRecord with model='sui' (tier='monetization' default, tier='defi_loop' for lend_*)
Stdlib-only — no `pysui` python package required; uses subprocess + json + urllib
Mainnet-gated writes — when SUI_NETWORK=mainnet, transfer_usdc/nft_mint/lend_pool_* require explicit confirm=true; devnet/testnet are free-fire
Graceful CLI failures — if `sui` is not on PATH, connect() returns False and send() emits SendResult(success=False, error='sui_not_connected')
Optional lending — lend_pool_* return SendResult(success=False, error='SUI_LENDING_PACKAGE_ID not set') when the env var is absent (no crash)
Redacted persistence — keypair, encryption_key, and confirm flags are stripped from params before crystallization (only addresses, amounts, ids persisted)
Wallet privacy — SUI_WALLET value is never printed by the CLI surface; only length / presence reported
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.sui_mcp import SuiMCPConnector
c = SuiMCPConnector()
c.connect()
r = c.send('query_balance', '{"addr":"0x…","coin_type":"0x2::sui::SUI"}')
print(r.metadata['total_balance'], r.crystal_id)
